findings.confidence: proven static user-reachable call path; not dynamically executed in this review
findings.title: class_view identity body request still elects first duplicate before no-Code admission
findings.public_entry: Engine::class_view(snapshot, scope, ClassViewRequest { class: ClassRef::Definition { definition }, bodies: vec![BodyRef::Method { method }] }, budget)
findings.physical_input: One complete class member table with two exact raw m/()V declarations: first abstract or native with no Code, second ordinary Code member. Reuse the existing method-v1 selection_class duplicate matrix; no new fixture or toolchain execution is needed to state the case.
findings.identity_qualification: PhysicalMethodId contains owner/name/descriptor only (model.rs:337-341). MethodItem has a separate index (facade.rs:40410-40416), but BodyRef::Method carries no index. Both duplicate MethodItems therefore hand back equal identities; passing the Code member identity cannot identify the second ordinal.

actual_call_chain.role: Public class_view binds one physical class, lists every method record, then resolves requested body refs.
Calls resolve_body_ref for every requested body before preparation.
BodyRef::Method correctly verifies owner identity, then only name/descriptor is used below; owner validation does not establish a unique member ordinal.
Calls declared_method and accepts its first match as BodyResolution::Method.
enumerate().find(raw name + raw descriptor) elects ordinal 0 without checking for another exact match.
requested_bodies is false for that first no-Code header, so no PreparedClass need be constructed for this one-body request.
The chosen member is passed directly to local body_result.
body_result returns ClassViewBody::NotDeclared from the first header before any shared decoder, charge or uniqueness guard.

findings.observable_result: With sufficient budget and a complete member table, the request is Performed with a NotDeclared/Abstract (or Native) body for an identity that matches two physical member records. The same raw name+descriptor BodyRef::Name takes the ambiguity candidate path instead. Reordering to Code first enters preparation/decoder and cannot use this early no-Code success.
findings.expected_boundary: A body request with duplicate exact matches must not claim a unique no-Code declaration merely because the first header has no Code. Keep raw record listing separate from selection; preserve foreign-owner validation first.
findings.why_uncovered: This call chain uses facade-local resolve_body_ref/declared_method/body_result and, in the failing no-Code case, calls neither jarde-jvm engine/callee nor PreparedClass::method_code. The formal three-file patch changes only engine.rs/callee.rs/tests/p3_prepared_input.rs.
findings.regression_suggestion: Add a class_view public-API duplicate test with BodyRef::Method constructed from either duplicate listing identity, covering [no-Code,Code], [Code,no-Code] and both-no-Code. Assert duplicate identity requests do not return a unique NotDeclared result, while the existing foreign-owner error remains first. Compare BodyRef::Name duplicate behavior. No broad every-find rewrite is justified.

checked_boundaries_without_additional_pr.boundary: Normal method analysis/recovery plus direct/prepared same-class callee
checked_boundaries_without_additional_pr.conclusion: The known early no-Code driver/callee defects are precisely the existing formal patch scope; not reported again as a new issue.
Collects all matching records and returns OperationOutcome::Ambiguous before body preparation/decoding for duplicate exact names/descriptors.

Enumerates each concrete MethodItem with its own index and passes that record to ClassSourceMethod::no_body; this is per-record presentation, not first-match election of one requested body. No independent selection error proved here.
Calls analyze_prepared_method_ir; the existing engine prepared uniqueness patch covers the original duplicate-before-body admission for this path.
Already rejects duplicate raw signatures before Code classification, even when an ordinal is supplied; the discovered facade no-Code branch bypasses that existing guard.
member_ordinal accepts exactly one locator result and otherwise returns None, so this sidecar does not elect a duplicate ordinal.
